headline: President Clinton changed Executive Order 12958, his April 1995 order on how the government classifies national security information.
what_it_does: This order makes a change to Executive Order 12958, which sets rules for how federal agencies classify, protect, and later release secret national security information. The title alone does not say what specific change was made.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that handle classified information
who_it_affects.how: They must follow the amended version of the classification rules in Executive Order 12958.
